neutral.EN: Heads up. Something's wrong out there.
Look alive. The situation outside is shifting.
neutral.TL: Maging alerto. Nagbabago ang sitwasyon sa labas.

neutral.EN: Pay attention. We have unexpected movement outside.
neutral.TL: Makinig ka. May di-inaasahang galaw sa labas.

neutral.EN: Warning. Something big is happening nearby.
neutral.TL: Babala. May malaking nangyayari sa malapit.

neutral.EN: Heads up, everyone. Check your gear.
neutral.TL: Mag-ingat ang lahat. Suriin ang mga gamit niyo.

neutral.EN: Listen close. An event is unfolding out there.
neutral.TL: Makinig nang mabuti. May kaganapan sa labas.

neutral.EN: Alert. We need to be ready for trouble.
neutral.TL: Alerto. Kailangan nating maging handa sa gulo.

neutral.EN: Keep your eyes open. That sound wasn't normal.
neutral.TL: Buksan ang mga mata. Hindi karaniwan ang tunog na 'yon.

neutral.EN: Stay sharp. The perimeter is showing activity.
neutral.TL: Maging alerto. May aktibidad sa paligid.

neutral.EN: Heads up. Let's not get caught unprepared.
neutral.TL: Mag-ingat. Huwag tayong mahuling walang paghahanda.

warm.EN: Stay close. Something's wrong out there.
warm.TL: Manatili kang malapit. May mali sa labas.

warm.EN: Stick by me, friend. We have trouble brewing outside.
warm.TL: Dumikit ka sa akin, kaibigan. May namumuong gulo sa labas.

warm.EN: Don't wander off. Something bad is moving out there.
warm.TL: Huwag kang lalayo. May masamang gumagalaw sa labas.

warm.EN: Keep close and stay low. I'll protect you.
warm.TL: Manatiling malapit at yumuko. Poprotektahan kita.

warm.EN: Hey, stay behind me until we know what that was.
warm.TL: Huy, manatili ka sa likod ko hanggang malaman natin 'yon.

warm.EN: Careful, everyone! Let's look out for one another.
warm.TL: Mag-ingat ang lahat! Magbantayan tayo sa isa't isa.

warm.EN: Hold on to each other. Danger is nearby.
warm.TL: Kumapit sa isa't isa. Malapit lang ang panganib.

warm.EN: Stay safe by my side. Trouble is coming.
warm.TL: Manatiling ligtas sa tabi ko. Parating ang panganib.

warm.EN: Heads up, partner. Whatever happens, we stick together.
warm.TL: Mag-ingat, kasama. Anuman ang mangyari, sama-sama tayo.

warm.EN: Keep close. I don't want anyone getting separated.
warm.TL: Dumikit ka. Ayokong may mahiwalay sa atin.

guarded.TL: Ibunot ang armas, ngayon na. May panganib sa labas.

guarded.EN: Shut up and listen. Something is coming.
Lock the doors and watch every angle.
guarded.TL: Ikandado ang pinto at bantayan ang bawat sulok.

guarded.EN: If it moves through that entrance, put it down.
guarded.TL: Kapag may gumalaw sa lagusang 'yan, patumbahin mo.

guarded.EN: Trouble's coming. Don't freeze up on me.
guarded.TL: Parating ang gulo. Huwag kang tatanga-tanga.

guarded.EN: Keep quiet. You don't want to draw them here.
guarded.TL: Manahimik ka. Ayaw mong maakit sila rito.

guarded.EN: Eyes on the perimeter. Shoot on sight.
guarded.TL: Bantayan ang paligid. Barilin agad kapag nakita.
